fullPassage: The difficult times that we endure play a key role in helping us to lead more meaningful lives. As Jean-Paul Sartre put it, "Human life begins on the far side of despair." That is, many of the ways people feel their lives are meaningful are grounded in the sufferings they have experienced. One research project investigated the differences between people who found their lives to be happy and those who found them to be meaningful. While, on average, happy lives and meaningful lives overlap a great deal, the researchers focused on those aspects of a meaningful life that were distinct from happiness. And, remarkably, they found that people who had more meaningful lives reported that they had more experience suffering through past negative events. They also reported worrying more and enduring more things that caused them stress. On the other hand, these past experiences with suffering tended to reduce people's overall levels of happiness. Our sufferings, then, seem to help to provide people with the sense that their lives are more meaningful, even if these events are associated with lower feelings of happiness.

questions.passage: And, __________ (remark), they found that people who had more meaningful lives reported that they had more experience suffering through past negative events.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사/형용사를 수식하는 부사가 필요한 자리. 동사 remark에서 형용사 remarkable을 거쳐 부사 remarkably로 변환. 'And, remarkably, they found that...'(그리고, 놀랍게도, 그들은 발견했다)

questions.passage: Our sufferings, then, seem to help to provide people with the sense that their lives are more meaningful, even if these events are __________ (associate) with lower feelings of happiness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 수동 관계를 나타내는 과거분사가 필요한 자리. 'these events are associated with'에서 be동사 + 과거분사 구조. 동사 associate를 과거분사 associated로 변환. '이 사건들이 낮은 행복감과 연관되어 있다'
det.tip: be associated with = ~와 연관되다. associate → associated(과거분사)

questions.passage: The difficult times that we endure play a key role in helping us to lead more meaningful lives. As Jean-Paul Sartre put it, "Human life begins on the far side of despair." That is, many of the ways people feel their lives are meaningful are grounded in the sufferings they have experienced. One research project investigated the differences between people who found their lives to be happy and those who found them to be meaningful. While, on average, happy lives and meaningful lives overlap a great deal, the researchers focused on those aspects of a meaningful life that were distinct from happiness. And, remarkably, they found that people who had more meaningful lives reported that they had more experience suffering through past negative events. They also reported worrying more and enduring more things that caused them stress. On the other hand, these past experiences with suffering tended to reduce people's overall levels of happiness. Our sufferings, then, seem to help to provide people with __________, even if these events are associated with lower feelings of happiness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 고통이 사람들에게 삶이 더 의미 있다는 ____을 제공하는 것 같다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the fear that their struggles are pointless: '투쟁이 무의미하다는 두려움'은 고통이 의미를 준다는 원문과 모순
❌ ② the desire to avoid all future hardships: '미래 고난을 피하고 싶은 욕구'는 본문의 핵심 내용과 무관
✅ ③ the sense that their lives are more meaningful: '삶이 더 의미 있다는 감각'은 고통이 의미를 부여한다는 원문과 일치 ← 정답
❌ ④ the proof that happiness is the ultimate goal: '행복이 궁극 목표라는 증거'는 오히려 고통이 행복을 줄인다는 원문과 모순

det.korean: 연구자들은 행복과 ____하는 의미 있는 삶의 측면에 초점을 맞췄다
det.analysis:
❌ ① were identical to: '동일했다'는 행복과 '구별되는(distinct)' 측면이라는 원문과 정반대
❌ ② contributed to: '기여했다'는 행복과의 관계를 설명하지만 원문의 '구별되는' 의미와 다름
❌ ③ depended on: '의존했다'는 행복과 의미 있는 삶의 구별이라는 맥락과 불일치
✅ ④ were distinct from: '구별되는'은 연구자들이 행복과 '구별되는' 의미 있는 삶의 측면에 초점을 맞췄다는 원문과 일치 ← 정답
